turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, they’re handled differently.

Damaged or defective item: This is handled through the warranty claim process. Submit the form with your order number, a clear photo or video, and a description of the issue. If approved, the available options are a replacement, if the same item is available, or store credit. Refunds are not offered for damaged items.
Normal return: EVRYJEWELS does not offer standard refunds, returns, or exchanges.

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
Once a warranty claim is approved, replacement orders are sent by standard shipping only. For orders within the US or Canada, most orders ship within 1–2 business days, followed by approximately 3–7 business days for standard delivery.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
Please include every affected item in your warranty claim submission. For each one, provide:

The item name
A clear photo or video
A short description of the issue

Also include your order number. The warranty applies once per item purchased, and all claims are subject to approval. If approved, the available options are a replacement of the exact same item and size, if available, or store credit. Refunds are not offered for damaged items.

Submit a warranty claim
